name: Mom's Magic
ingredients_raw: REFINED WHEAT FLOUR (MAIDA), REFINED PALM OIL, SUGAR, INVERT SYRUP, BUTTER (1%), MILK SOLIDS, RAISING AGENTS [INS 503(ii), INS 500(ii), INS 450(i)), IODIZED SALT, EMULSIFIERS [LECITHIN (FROM SOYABEAN), MONO - AND DI-GLYCERIDES OF FATTY ACIDS (FROM PALM OIL), DIACETYL TARTARIC ACID ESTER OF MONO - AND DIGLYCERIDES (FROM SUNFLOWER & PALM OIL)], NATURE IDENTICAL FLAVOURING SUBSTANCES (BUTTER), COLOUR (INS 150a) AND ARTIFICIAL FLAVOURING SUBSTANCES (VANILLA). CONTAINS WHEAT, MILK, SOY. MAY CONTAIN NUT, SULPHITE.
